snippet.title: Ultraprocessor Ribbon - Opening Trailer
snippet.description:
In 2673, every old computer must be slaughtered, but a girl will turn her 2002 PC into a beautiful combat android to fight back. A loving tribute to Y2K-era bishoujo games that also looks to the future!

Launching September 3rd, 2026 exclusively on JAST.

https://jaststore.com/games/demu001/ultraprocessor-ribbon
https://demuresoft.xyz/ribbon/ribbon.php
